title: fix(rest)!: a per-object bulk door whose rows failed answers 207 Multi-Status, not 200
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4RRSW3REWSaCM6meeMVN6r)_

Fixes #32280

Clause-②: yes (narrowing): a batch / updateMany / deleteMany with failed rows answered 200 and now answers 207
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names the per-object batch door (`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` lines 50, 257, 392) but teaches no HTTP status for it, nor for `updateMany` / `deleteMany`; nothing there states the 200 this PR changes

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:按对象的三个批量写入口(`/data/:object/batch`、`/updateMany`、`/deleteMany`)只要有一行失败就回 `207 Multi-Status`,全部成功仍回 `200`;响应体一字不变。
- **为什么改**:以前整批全失败也回 `200 {success:false}`,只看 HTTP 状态码的集成会把失败的批量当成写入成功。
- **风险与回滚**:`207` 仍是 2xx,SDK 与控制台照常拿到逐行结果;只影响把状态码写死成 `200` 才读结果的外部脚本。回滚即撤销 `batch-routes.ts` 里的 `bulkReportStatus` 三处调用。
- **先看**:`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts`(`bulkReportStatus` 与三处 `res.status(...)`)、`packages/client/src/client.hono.test.ts`(真实服务器上 SDK 仍解析 207)、`content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-bulk-multi-status.test.ts`,预期 12 passed;有失败行的用例断言 207,全成功的对照断言 200。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` gains one module-private function, `bulkReportStatus(report)`: `207` when the report's `failed` is a number above zero, else `200`. The three per-object doors that answer a per-row `BatchUpdateResponse` call `res.status(bulkReportStatus(result)).json(result)` where they called `res.json(result)`:

| Door | Every row failed | Some rows failed | No row failed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `POST /data/:object/batch` | 200 → **207** | 200 → **207** | 200 |
| `POST /data/:object/updateMany` | 200 → **207** | 200 → **207** | 200 |
| `POST /data/:object/deleteMany` | 200 → **207** | 200 → **207** | 200 |

The body is the same object either way. Judged on `failed`, the field the protocol builds the report's own `success` from (`buildBatchDataResponse`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-batch-data.ts`). An atomic batch that rolled back reports every row failed (`ROLLED_BACK` / the causal code / `NOT_ATTEMPTED`), so it answers 207 too. A report without a numeric `failed` keeps 200.

**Not changed, per the seat's ruling.** `createMany` answers no per-row report: it answers `201`, and a row it refuses fails the whole call with that row's error status (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED` for a validation failure, `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` for an owner refusal, as #32169's phase-1 report measured). The cross-object `POST /batch` is always atomic and refuses the same way. Neither reaches `bulkReportStatus`.

**Second transport: none.** The runtime dispatcher's `/data` domain serves no batch, `updateMany` or `deleteMany` verb (`packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts`, the route-ownership note at the `batch` comment: batching has one owner, `registerBatchEndpoints`). MCP names `deleteMany` only in a comment (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`); it serves no bulk tool. `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` carries no row for these routes, and the OpenAPI builtin paths answer `default` only for them (`openapi-builtin-paths.ts`), so neither states a 200.

**SDK and console census.** `packages/client/src/index.ts`'s shared `fetch` throws only on `!res.ok`; `unwrapResponse` reads the body without looking at the status. `data.batch`, `data.updateMany`, `data.deleteMany` on both the root client and the environment-scoped client resolve on 207 (pinned below over a real server). `ui/packages/data-objectstack` calls `client.data.updateMany` / `deleteMany` and reads the report; no non-test reader under `ui/packages/**` or `packages/client*/src` tests a status for exactly 200 on these doors. The one hit, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/demo/bulk-actions.tsx`, is a demo's own mock `fetch`, not a reader of these doors. No reader needed a fix, so the SDK has no behaviour change.

**Docs.** `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` states the 200 / 207 split for `/batch`, `/updateMany` and `/deleteMany`, and that `createMany` never answers 207. `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx`'s batch section (flagged by the Docs Drift Check) names 207 for its partial-failure example; its all-success example keeps `200 OK`. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json` item `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` steps[0] said the per-object `/batch` door "answers 200 with a per-row report"; it now says 207 when a row fails (200 when none does), revision 8 with its history row. No clause changed.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/rest-bulk-multi-status.test.ts` (new, 12 cases): each of the three doors, every row failed → 207 and the body is the protocol's report object unchanged; one of two rows failed → 207; CONTROL, no row failed → 200 and no 207 was set; a report with no numeric `failed` → 200.
- `packages/client/src/client.hono.test.ts` (4 new cases) on a real `LiteKernel` + `HonoServerPlugin` + REST plugin + SQLite: `updateMany` with two ids no record has → 207 on the wire, and `client.data.updateMany` resolves with a report equal to the wire body; `batch` with one real and one missing row → 207, and `client.data.batch` resolves with the landed row (re-read through `data.get`); `deleteMany` with two missing ids → 207, and `client.data.deleteMany` resolves the same report; CONTROL, every row succeeded → 200 and the SDK resolves.
- Stale status pins moved from 200 to 207 (each is a report with a failed row): `packages/rest/src/data-not-null-field-label-24715.test.ts` (batch create row with no value), and the dogfood files `field-unique-rest-refusal` (atomic updateMany), `grant-table-write-contract` (updateMany + batch create, comment too), `secret-field-delete-release` (atomic deleteMany rollback), `showcase-readonly-when-parent` (continueOnError updateMany, and the stop-at-first-failure CONTRAST). Their all-success cases keep 200.

<details><summary>Ablation of the status choice (both pins, two legs, restored)</summary>

Committed first (`18daadc4`), mutated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor `return typeof failed === 'number' && failed > 0 ? 207 : 200;` → a body that always returns 200.

- **rest unit leg** (subject resolves `src/`): anchor 1 → 0, blob `95144fb76504` → `16e02801d0c7`. `rest-bulk-multi-status.test.ts`: `Tests 6 failed | 6 passed (12)`, every failure `AssertionError: expected 200 to be 207`; the six CONTROL and no-`failed` cases stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **SDK leg** (`@objectstack/client` resolves `@objectstack/rest` through `dist/`): mutation `--hold`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest build`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/rest 'ABLATION-32280'` → `marker present in 2 built files`. `client.hono.test.ts`: `Tests 3 failed | 6 passed (9)`, the three 207 cases each `expected 200 to be 207`; the CONTROL stayed green. First attempt used a comment marker the bundle strips (preflight: marker ABSENT, nothing run), re-done with a code-level marker. Restore: blob == HEAD, rebuild, preflight `--absent` → `marker absent from all 6 built files`, `working tree clean against HEAD`, suite back to `Tests 9 passed (9)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The order's seat ruling holds: trigger is `failed > 0`, not `succeeded === 0`.
- `createMany`'s whole-call refusal is unchanged (ruling): one bulk door still answers a 4xx where its siblings answer a 207 report. That is the documented shape now, in the same page.

## Verification

All local readings are on head `53e37be2` (after one merge of `origin/main` at `f71bb413`) unless a line says otherwise. The final head `d7fc4223` differs from it only by `content/docs/api/wire-format.mdx` (+2 prose lines); the docs-reading families re-ran there, 21/21 exit 0. CI's check-runs on this PR are the authority for every family CI runs.

All 97 ran on `53e37be2`, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciles: `97 derived, 97 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Three built-output families read exit 3 on that pass and were re-measured after the builds: `check:skill-examples` (344 examples type-check), `check:type-check-debt` (128/131 packages, 0 debt), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needed an unshallow clone; 48 cases).

- **Package suites.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: `Test Files 401 passed (401)`, `Tests 7694 passed | 332 skipped`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client test`: `Test Files 57 passed (57)`, `Tests 804 passed`. `typecheck` for `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/dogfood`: exit 0 (the new rest test first failed `check:test-typecheck` on a hand-built request literal; it now uses `httpRequestForRoute`).

Earlier passes read the same counts on `bf54cd1b` and `448 passed | 3 skipped`, `3739 passed | 42 skipped` on `408b48e5` (before the merge).
